caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug with a wide rim, a rounded body that narrows towards the top, and a thick, curved handle attached to the right side. The mug sits on a round, slightly raised base. The surface of the mug appears shiny with soft highlights and subtle shading that suggest a reflective, silver or pewter-like material. The background is a plain, light beige color with some gentle gradient and subtle speckling, and there are no other objects or decorations around the mug. The artist's signature, "Holger Hansen," is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Mug
